brief.subject: Rope segment with a small lit lantern hanging at the bottom — rope weave on top rows, lantern graphic in bottom rows
brief.gameplayMeaning: Texture for the rope_lantern block: a rope column whose bottom element is a 6x6x8 lantern (side faces use uv rows 0-7, columns 5-10). The lantern must read as a glowing vanilla-style lantern hanging from the rope
visualPriority: first read as a lantern at native 16x16
then show warm glow with metal cap and frame
top rows continue the rope weave so the column blends with plain rope

mustHave: lantern centered in columns 5-10, bottom rows 0-8
dark metal top cap and bottom cap, orange glass with bright center
rope weave in the top rows (vertical strand stripes acceptable)
